title: Black Knight
subtitle: Dane Whitman and the burden of the Ebony Blade.
intro: This guide follows Dane Whitman, the Avenger, rather than Sir Percy or Nathan Garrett. His key stories often live in team books. Start with Curse of the Ebony Blade for a compact modern introduction, or Captain Britain and MI13 for a team run.

stories.title: Dane Whitman becomes the Black Knight
stories.match: Avengers Epic: Masters of Evil covers #41–56, including both debut issues. This is a team collection, not a solo Black Knight book.

stories.title: The Avengers/Defenders War
stories.why: Dane’s fate is central to the conflict, though much of the action belongs to the two teams.
stories.match: The Avengers/Defenders War Epic collects both sides of the crossover and additional surrounding issues.

stories.title: Under Siege
stories.why: A classic Avengers crisis featuring Dane among the defenders of the mansion.
stories.match: The Under Siege Epic covers #264–277; the collection starts before the core siege story.

stories.title: The Gatherers: Dane & Sersi’s turning point
stories.why: A pivotal Dane/Sersi chapter. Start earlier in the Gatherers saga for the full setup.
stories.match: The Gathering Epic covers #367–377 and crossover material. It supplies the conclusion, not the entire #343–375-era saga. Earlier Gatherers setup is not confirmed here.

stories.title: Captain Britain and MI13
stories.why: A recommended supernatural-team home for Dane.
stories.match: Read all three in order: Secret Invasion (#1–4), Hell Comes to Birmingham (#5–9), then Vampire State (#10–15). These volumes continue one another; they are not alternatives. Annual #1 inclusion in the last edition is not established by its catalog title.

stories.title: The Fall of Dane Whitman
stories.why: A short solo run for the sword-and-sorcery side of Dane.
stories.match: The Fall of Dane Whitman collects the complete five-issue series. The two other Weirdworld series are related setting material, not substitutes.

stories.title: Curse of the Ebony Blade
stories.issues: Black Knight: Curse of the Ebony Blade (2021) #1–5
stories.why: A modern solo entry that revisits the blade and Dane’s legacy.
stories.match: The exact five-issue collection is in your catalog. Later Black Knight material should be read after this series.
